nodes.label: AES-256-CBC Encryption
nodes.rationale: Industry standard, approved for TOP SECRET; unique IV per operation prevents pattern analysis.

nodes.label: PBKDF2-SHA256 (100,000 iterations)
nodes.rationale: Slow KDF prevents brute force; 100k iterations balances security/performance per OWASP.
